Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 29: the slip of [[Precision Targeting (V)#Source formats|Precision Targeting (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. Your capital starship weapon destiny draws are +1. During your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to ▼ a starship weapon (for free) on your capital starship. If a starship was just hit, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to make that starship forfeit = 0.”), word for word the text of [[Precision Targeting (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
